Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Cylindrical Stoneware Candle Holder Lantern Home Decor Set - Set of 2, Gray and Cream
These 2 stoneware lanterns boast an elegant reactive glaze with flecks of blue. Light from a votive candle can shine through the rectangular cutouts, and the handles provide easy transport. 6.57" Diameter x 10.04"H; 6.55" Diameter x 8.25"H 100% stoneware Can be used with candles or on their own
